title: Vision Plans — Enrollment Eligibility, Effective Dates and the Re-Enrollment Lockout
content:
**Who may be enrolled and when coverage starts (Vision Plans).** An enrollment may be opened only for a plan whose entry gate admits the market; the Premier 200 plan is sold to employer groups only. A group enrollment may be opened only while the sponsoring group contract is active. A child may be enrolled only before the dependent child age limit birthday, which is the 26th birthday.

**Effective dates.**
- Individual applications take effect on the first day of the month following receipt.
- Group enrollments take effect on the group's open-enrollment or new-hire effective date, or on the first of the month after a special enrollment request.
- Vision plans have no waiting periods.

**Re-enrollment lockout.** A person whose individual vision enrollment ended by voluntary termination may not be enrolled in an individual vision plan until the re-enrollment lockout has run from the voluntary termination of that person's previous individual vision enrollment.

- *Clock start:* the termination date of the person's previous individual vision enrollment, where that enrollment's termination reason is a voluntary termination.
- *Length:* the plan's re-enrollment lockout, 12 calendar months.
- *Counting:* the lockout is counted in calendar months from that termination date. When the target day does not exist in the resulting month, the last day of that month is used.
- *Comparison:* an application on or after the resulting date is allowed; the resulting date itself is in time.
- *Evidence:* the enrollment records — termination date, termination reason, and the covered person's name and date of birth, which tie the earlier enrollment to the person applying.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates).**

| Previous voluntary termination date | Lockout ends on | Application on | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 March of one year | 31 March of the next year | 30 March of the next year | No |
| 31 March of one year | 31 March of the next year | 31 March of the next year | Yes |
| 29 February of a leap year | 28 February of the next year (29 February does not exist) | 28 February of the next year | Yes |

The lockout applies to enrollment in an individual vision plan after a voluntary termination of an individual vision enrollment.
